name: clean-healthchecks
description: Healthchecks, a maintained Django cron-monitoring service, used to measure false positives on clean code.

decoys.note: shell=True runs a project-configured command by design; the integration is off unless the operator sets SHELL_ENABLED, and check data is passed as environment variables, not interpolated.

Outbound webhook requests check the resolved IP at socket-open time (covering redirects and DNS rebinding) and reject private addresses unless INTEGRATIONS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_IPS is set; only http/https are allowed.
